instructions:
Practice the LSP keys on a small TypeScript project.

0. Run `vimdrill --check` once. It creates the project in ~/vim-mastery/practice/11.3
   (and reports "not done yet"). To start over: rm -rf that folder and run --check again.
1. cd ~/vim-mastery/practice/11.3 && nvim src/main.ts
2. Diagnostics: ]d jumps to the first error, Ctrl-w d shows the full message.
   There are two problems: formatPrice isn't imported, and `total` has the wrong type.
3. On formatPrice, press gra and pick the import fix (it reads 'Update import from "./cart"',
   because main.ts already imports from there).
4. Fix `const total: string` to `number` (ciw...). ]d should now find nothing.
5. Ctrl-] on `calc` jumps to its definition in cart.ts. Press grn THERE and rename it to
   calculateTotal. The import and the call in main.ts change too. Ctrl-o takes you back.
   (Renaming at the call site in main.ts only adds a local alias, `calc as calculateTotal`.)
6. Explore without a check: K on Item (hover), grr on Item (references, then :cnext/:cclose),
   gO (outline), Ctrl-s inside calculateTotal( ... ) in insert mode.
7. :wa to save everything, then vimdrill --check.

Read more: :help lsp-defaults, :help diagnostic-defaults
